goal: transcribe(faster_whisper): batch long-run windows and truncated-tail recoveries, and record segment stats on long runs (issue #70)

criteria.statement: Multi-window long_runs are decoded via batched clip_timestamps (batch_size=bs) rather than one _decode call per window, and still pass through decode_windows(..., cut_seams=True)
last_segment_stats includes segment stats (with global start_ms/end_ms) from long_runs as well as normal spans
FasterWhisperEngine unit tests and regression engine tests pass
